description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for WebAudioPlayer and its factory within the Rialto client media component. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to WebAudioPlayer functionality.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implementation of IWebAudioPlayer, IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient, and IControlClient for managing web audio playback.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory::createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::play
methods.description: Starts playback of the audio stream.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the player.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device-related information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the player of a change in WebAudioPlayerState.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayer::notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies the player of a change in ApplicationState.
